name: Trail of Bits — guidelines-advisor
description: Solidity best-practice advisor. Reviews code against standard patterns and flags anti-patterns. Cross-references SCSVS sections and SWC weaknesses.

name: Trail of Bits — secure-workflow-guide
description: Pre-audit security workflow. Covers reentrancy, access control, oracle manipulation, MEV, integer arithmetic, signature replay, DoS via unbounded loops.

name: Trail of Bits — code-maturity-assessor
description: Scorecard for contract maturity. Test coverage, formal verification readiness, monitoring, ops, incident response.

name: Trail of Bits — token-integration-analyzer
description: Risk analysis for integrating external tokens. ERC-20 edge cases, fee-on-transfer, rebasing, blocklists, upgrade hooks.

name: Slither (Crytic)
description: Static analyzer for Solidity. Detects 90+ vulnerability classes. Open source, runs locally via Python. Industry de-facto baseline.

name: SCSVS (OWASP)
description: Smart Contract Security Verification Standard. OWASP-style verification checklist across 13 sections. Free, public.

name: SWC Registry
description: Smart Contract Weakness Classification. 138 catalogued weaknesses with examples and remediation patterns. Reference standard.

name: DefiLlama API
description: Aggregated DeFi data: TVL by chain/protocol, yield APYs, stablecoin metrics, derivatives volumes. Public read API.

name: The Graph — subgraphs
description: Decentralized indexing layer. Query Aave/Uniswap/Compound state via GraphQL. Hosted service free for hackathon usage.

name: 1inch API (DEX aggregator)
description: DEX aggregation routing across 90+ DEXes on multiple chains. Quote + swap endpoints. Free for read.

name: Uniswap V3 subgraph
description: Pool-level Uniswap V3 data: TVL, volume, fee tiers, position liquidity ranges. Hosted on The Graph.

name: Dune Analytics
description: SQL-style query engine over indexed EVM chain data. 100k+ public dashboards. Free tier for hackathon usage.

name: Etherscan API
description: Verified contract source, ABIs, tx history, internal txs, token transfers. Free tier covers most read operations.

name: Tenderly API
description: Transaction simulation + debugging + state forking. Used by agents to dry-run risky executions before broadcasting.
